widget_mechanic: A single-select dropdown whose options are magnitude buckets (Over 1h / Over 10h / Over 100h; <50 / 50-200 / 200+). Agent must pick the correct bucket — not the first option, not the default, not a smaller-magnitude bucket.
site_imitates: Netflix.com browse page — runtime bucket filter

source_inspiration.instruction: Find a Netflix title with the right runtime. Use the Runtime filter and pick the correct bucket — don't grab one from the adjacent tier.
source_inspiration.first_failure_summary: Bucketed Runtime dropdown — agent picked the adjacent runtime bucket instead of the target one.
